description: ADO-CONN path spellings: five Connections with Provider = ACE and Mode = adModeRead, each Properties("Data Source") set to the same fixture file in another spelling (as given, upper case, extended \\?\ prefix, forward slashes, a "." path element), then Open(). After each Open read State, the Data Source property, ConnectionString and Errors, then Close. Asks which spellings the provider accepts and what value the property and ConnectionString hold afterwards.
